title: Extraction prompts cleanly stripped of ICD-10, diagnosis and history

test_cases.name: ER extraction prompt clean
test_cases.expected_result: Diagnosis and ICD-10 codes explicitly excluded from ER prompt
test_cases.evidence: ER prompt clean: explicitly forbids diagnoses and ICD-10 extraction

test_cases.name: OPD extraction prompt clean
test_cases.expected_result: No diagnosis section present in OPD extraction instructions
test_cases.evidence: OPD prompt clean: diagnosis generation excluded

test_cases.name: Dental extraction prompt clean
test_cases.expected_result: No diagnosis section present in Dental extraction instructions
test_cases.evidence: Dental prompt clean: diagnosis generation excluded

test_cases.name: Output extraction schemas clean of diagnosis keys
test_cases.input_setup: Check field keys on ERExtractionOutput, OPDExtractionOutput, DentalExtractionOutput
test_cases.expected_result: Zero diagnosis or ICD-10 keys present in extraction schemas
test_cases.evidence: All 3 department extraction schemas confirmed clean of diagnosis and ICD-10 keys

test_cases.name: Extraction model symptom focus
test_cases.input_setup: Instantiate ER extraction model with acute presentation
test_cases.expected_result: Focuses on complaints, physical survey, and plan; diagnosis absent
test_cases.evidence: Extraction model captures clinical symptoms and plan while strictly omitting diagnosis fields
